thumb.alt: Spend audit for an AI coding assistant

title: Spend audit for an AI coding assistant
lead: Reads the assistant's logs and shows where the money goes and what is wasted, all on your own machine.
problem: The bill keeps growing and nobody can say what it is made of. People want to see spend by project and session and find where money is lost.
built: A report: spend by project, day, session and kind, and what the cache saved.
A look at the conversation history: what it carries and when compacting pays.
Waste detection with 8 rules (repeated reads, loops, oversized command output, failing calls and more); each finding has evidence, a cost estimate and a fix.
A 'did it get cheaper?' check with an interval and a noise floor.

shots.caption: Waste findings with evidence and a cost estimate.
shots.alt: Waste findings with evidence and a cost estimate.

steps: The tool reads your local session logs; nothing leaves the machine.
It groups spend by project, day, session and kind.
Eight rules flag waste, each with evidence and a cost estimate.
You get a report and a list of recommendations.
offer: Analysis of your logs: a report and a list of recommendations.
not_included: A guaranteed saving in percent; Other tools (the tool supports one); Packaging it as a product for your team.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
